title: Meta updates its crawling terms effective October 30
content:
X author: @bombomelon

Meta rewrote its crawling and scraping terms, effective October 30, applying to sites linked to business accounts; its documentation states that robots.txt can still block its AI crawler.

Linked sources:
- None supplied

novelty.reason: This reports on the same update to Meta's commercial and business terms permitting crawling and scraping across associated domains that was previously reported.
